headline: AI Daily Brief titles Anthropic's first day of trading; still no first-party S1

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: It's just after eight UTC on Friday, November twentieth. This is ARA AI News.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: The A I Daily Brief now titles Anthropic's first day of trading. This morning we were still saying November nineteenth had passed with no S one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: The new episode is a twenty-six minute countdown of the ten biggest days in A I history, and the show notes put Anthropic's I P O on that list with Chat G P T and the Deep Seek sell-off. Captions are not up, so we are not treating a title as a tape.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: We still have no first-party S one, no priced deal, and no exchange listing in our sources. What moved this afternoon is a podcast headline, not a prospectus.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: That headline goes further than this morning's commentary. Twenty V C had billed a one point five trillion dollar largest-ever I P O, and A I Explained had already titled its episode as if the listing were happening.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: The last spoken numbers have not been replaced. Latent Space had speakers saying the book was about seven times oversubscribed around eighty dollars a share, with margins from nineteen percent to fifteen, and a slight G A A P loss they called intentional.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: Twelve thousand customers over a hundred thousand dollars and about seventy percent of compute still on training also still stand. Anthropic's own fifteen-minute founders video still has no captions, and Nvidia as a ten billion dollar anchor is still the last named check.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Nvidia did not move this afternoon. The last eight K still names Colette Kress as interim C E O, and this morning's Daily Brief was already saying the board is refusing to bring Jensen Huang back.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: That remains a podcast claim, not a filing. The fourth-quarter outlook still assumes no China data-center compute, and there is still no eight K on a permanent chief.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: On models, G P T six point two Astra is where we left it. The Daily Brief had called the first impressions some of the worst on record, then argued the efficiency numbers tell a different story.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: A I Explained still calls Astra OpenAI's best model, and says Gemini is catching up with Four Carbon and Neon. Qwen four remains unconfirmed from Alibaba.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Watch for a real Anthropic S one or an exchange listing, for captions on this Daily Brief countdown, and for any Nvidia eight K that names a permanent C E O.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: That's ARA AI News. We'll be back when the picture changes.
